2026-05-07 — clean-slate session before resuming Bun migration. Pure foundation work; no feature commits.

DONE THIS SESSION (3 commits on origin/main):
- Fast-forwarded local main to e8ed078 (was 19 behind from 2026-05-06 evening rebrand work). Dropped a redundant local commit (f51410a, only added .mcp.json which origin already had). Reconciled untracked .reverie/ via rebase.
- d837110 docs(reverie): refresh context.devWorkflow for rvr-dev binaries (the entry still said "cclid / cclid-mcp ... never ccli" even though the deep rebrand renamed them to rvr-dev / rvr-dev-mcp).
- b888cea docs(reverie): clear C-bucket residue from store. 33 entries swept (codex_* → reverie_*, CODEX_* → RVR_*, .codexcli/ → .reverie/, ccli → rvr, "the codex" → "Reverie" incl. seedDensity metaphor). project.storeResidueC removed (work complete, methodology in git history at b888cea). Preserved legitimate legacy mentions: ".codexcli.json" migration source in arch.scope/arch.storage/arch.storeLayout, "Renamed from cclid" backref in context.devWorkflow.

ALSO DONE (no commit; environment work):
- npm dev link refreshed: removed stale codexcli/cclid/cclid-mcp global symlinks (target dir gone since repo rename), npm link as @seabear/reverie@1.0.0-beta.1, rvr-dev and rvr-dev-mcp now in PATH.
- ~/.zshrc cleaned: stale `ccli` wrapper block (lines 495-521) deleted; rvr-beta block already in place at lines 523+. zsh -n parses clean.

NEXT SESSION PICKS UP — Bun commit-phase (v1.0.0-beta.2):
1. PRE-FLIGHT: one-line fix in src/storage.ts: `export { Scope }` → `export type { Scope }`. Required for raw-TS Bun execution. Documented in project.bunValidate issue #3.
2. SWAP: replace scripts/sea-build.js (~140 lines: esbuild bundle → SEA blob → postject inject → codesign) with `bun build --compile` (~20-30 lines). Drops esbuild + postject from devDependencies. Per project.bunMigrationScope.
3. CI: macOS job simplifies (drop Node x64 tarball download; bun cross-compiles via --target=bun-darwin-x64 from arm64 runner). Keep `lipo -create` + `codesign --sign -` for universal binary.
4. VALIDATION: `bun build --compile` output structurally differs from `bun dist/mcp-server.js` (which IS already verified byte-identical to Node per project.bunValidate). Need a debug-tag rerun (v0.0.0-debug.0 pattern from #96) to confirm the compiled binary behaves identically before tagging beta.2.
5. Recommended split per project.bunValidate: keep vitest under Node for tests, ship Bun for production (Option A). Test-runner swap deferred to v1.1+.

DON'T (next bootstrap):
- Re-do the C-bucket sweep (b888cea closed it; project.storeResidueC removed).
- Re-derive Bun migration scope (saved in project.bunValidate + project.bunMigrationScope).
- Cut a release tag autonomously — user-driven moment.
- Re-link npm package (linked this session as @seabear/reverie; rvr-dev / rvr-dev-mcp in PATH).
- Re-touch ~/.zshrc (cleaned this session).

ENVIRONMENT NOTES:
- This project's MCP server runs as `rvr-beta` (1.0.0-beta.1, Homebrew Cellar) per .mcp.json. Local rvr-dev points at the dist/ build for development.
- bun.lock and .mcp.json are now committed on origin/main.
- npm @seabear/reverie still NOT published to registry (Homebrew + GitHub binary download are the user-facing install paths).

USER STATE: Wants a clean slate to resume Bun migration. Foundation now sound — local main aligned with origin, dev tooling functional, store self-consistent across all current-state references. No outstanding cleanup before the next-session pre-flight item.
